I went to primary school for a few years, so I can read the numbers on a bag and do some counting, but I learned farming from my father and from watching what works in my village. This plot is only 0.12 hectares and it is not mine—I am renting it—so I will not put fertilizer or bought seed into this land. One bag of NPK costs too much for such a small piece, and one bag would be enough for nearly a whole hectare anyway. I will plant local seed that I kept from last season, my wife and children will help me weed and harvest, and I will not hire anyone because I need to keep my cash for the plots I actually own.
